original_post_text: The Lodge is back in business.
expanded_title: The Lodge Is Back in Business: Doors Reopen in Round Rock Two Months After the March Raid
expanded_deck: Two weeks after a Williamson County grand jury declined all proposed charges, Texas's largest poker room officially reopens its doors in Round Rock.
expanded_body:
Originally posted May 12, 2026.

The Lodge is back in business.

Two months after the March 10 raid shuttered its Round Rock doors and froze its accounts — and two weeks after a Williamson County grand jury returned a no-bill on April 28 declining all proposed charges — The Lodge Card Club has officially reopened in May 2026, putting dealers, floor staff, and players back on the felt at Texas's largest poker room.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
